h1: Keep your Roxborough Park yard green while new lawns are on hold.
lede: Aurora's Stage 1 drought rules reach Roxborough through its water district, and they rule out new cool-weather turf. Start with a free visit to measure the yard and check the ground.
wins: No assigned watering days to plan around
A layout ready for design review

answer.question: Can I put in a new grass lawn in Roxborough Park right now?
answer.answer: Not a new cool-weather lawn. Roxborough Water and Sanitation District buys its water from Aurora and has to apply Aurora's drought rules. Aurora's Stage 1 surcharges reached the district on 7 April 2026 and stay in force until Aurora announces they have ended; the Stage 1 list bans new cool-weather turf installation. The district's summer watering schedule runs 1 May to 1 October and gives existing lawns two assigned days a week within that window. Artificial turf needs no watering, but on a Roxborough Park Foundation lot it still needs design approval first.

blocks.h2: The rule on new lawns comes from a city Roxborough isn't part of.
paras: Roxborough Park is unincorporated Douglas County (Roxborough Park), but its water is Aurora's. The district buys raw water from the City of Aurora, takes its contracted share from Strontia Springs Reservoir just west of Roxborough, and under an agreement revised in 2017 must apply the drought restrictions Aurora sets (Roxborough Water and Sanitation District).

Aurora's Stage 1 surcharges reached the district on 7 April 2026 and stay until Aurora announces they have ended. The district's Stage 1 list comes with them: outdoor irrigation two days a week on assigned days, nothing between 10 a.m. and 6 p.m., no new cool-weather turf installation, no filling private pools (topping off is allowed) and no decorative water features. A first violation brings a warning, the second a fine on your water bill, and repeats bring escalating fines and potential service interruption (Roxborough Water and Sanitation District).

If you were planning to sod or reseed, ask the district office before anything is delivered. Its summer schedule graphic still sends you to the office for a watering permit for spring plantings, seed or new sod, while the Stage 1 list rules out new cool-weather turf. The list says nothing about artificial turf, which needs no watering at all. Aurora's storage table read 43% full, rated Low, on 7 September 2026 (Aurora Water).

blocks.h2: Which part of Roxborough you're in sets your two days.
paras: The district's schedule runs 1 May to 1 October. Homes in Roxborough Park and Ravenna water Friday and Tuesday. In Roxborough Village, homes west of Rampart Range Road water Saturday and Wednesday, and homes east of it, including Chatfield Acres, Chatfield East, Chatfield Estates and Plum Valley Heights, water Sunday and Thursday. Mondays need a permit. Hand watering and drip systems are always allowed (Roxborough Water and Sanitation District).

That shapes the plan. Beds and trees you keep can stay on drip; decide which sprinkler zones stay before the layout is drawn. Don't budget on a rebate: the district's rebates are for high-efficiency washers and toilets. Our water rebates guide covers the rest of the metro.

blocks.h2: On a Foundation lot, synthetic turf is allowed with approval.
paras: Not every Roxborough address belongs to the Roxborough Park Foundation, so check your closing papers first; its governing documents are public. For Foundation lots, the Design Review Document revised on 19 September 2024 says non-vegetative turf grass shall not be prohibited, subject to reasonable aesthetic criteria and prior approval. It means synthetic grass of at least a medium pile, approved in writing by the Design Review Committee, and it bars outdoor carpeting or anything the committee finds doesn't pass for grass (Roxborough Park Foundation DRD).

Landscaping changes at an existing home need the committee's approval before work starts, and turf isn't on the short list of exceptions. Send the Request for Design Approval form, with drawings showing property lines and setbacks, dimensions and material samples, to the office at least three business days before a regular committee meeting. A letter follows within three business days, and nothing starts until it approves. Approved changes to existing landscaping must be finished within seven months.

Call the design review coordinator to ask whether your change needs a formal landscaping plan. If it does, it's drawn over the site plan at one inch to ten feet and shows existing and proposed grading. Outside the Foundation, ask whether an association covers your lot; our Colorado HOA turf guide explains what one can decide.

blocks.h2: Rock at the edges, and the drainage left alone.
paras: The DRD says Foundation homes sit in the Wildland-Urban Interface. Its fire guidelines say to avoid wood mulch within five feet of the house, never to use highly flammable rubber mulch, and to break up vegetation with earth-tone rock, gravel and stepping-stone paths. Where turf meets the house, an earth-tone rock border fits those guidelines better than bark. The rubber rule is written about mulch, so ask the committee which infill it accepts before you choose one (Roxborough Park Foundation DRD).

The same document lists landscape-planning items to consider, and they're not all rules. Existing natural drainage paths shall be preserved is the one mandatory line. The rest is guidance: avoid large, manicured areas, and conserve rock formations and unique landscape features. A turf area sized to how you'll use it, framed by rock and native grass, fits all three.

faq.q: Who installs artificial turf in Roxborough Park, CO?
faq.a: We install artificial turf, pet turf and backyard putting greens in Roxborough Park, CO. Aurora's Stage 1 rules, applied by the water district, rule out new cool-weather turf, and Foundation lots need design approval first. Call 303-349-2368 for a free estimate.

faq.q: Where can a dog run go on a Roxborough Park Foundation lot?
faq.a: Somewhere the neighbors can't see it. The Protective Covenants, recorded in 2004, put dog runs, kennels and enclosed pet areas under design review and require them in a location not visible from any other lot, unit, common area or the golf course (Roxborough Park Foundation Protective Covenants). Show the screening in the turf packet.

faq.q: Will the water district pay a rebate for artificial turf?
faq.a: Roxborough Water and Sanitation District's rebates are for approved high-efficiency washers and toilets (Roxborough Water and Sanitation District).

faq.q: How long will Stage 1 last in Roxborough?
faq.a: Until Aurora ends it. The district says the surcharges stay in effect until Aurora announces they have ended (Roxborough Water and Sanitation District), and Aurora's drought page still showed Stage 1 when we checked on 12 September 2026 (Aurora Water). Ask the district before you plan a new cool-weather lawn.
